newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 451 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 451 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 451 contracts compared with 335 overnight Monday, according to the CBOT.
There were 85 wheat, 170 corn, 180 soybean, four soymeal, 10 oat and two soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one to 1-1/4 cents higher, corn was 1/2 to 1-1/4 cents higher and soybeans were two to 2-1/4 cents higher.
